title: Hermitian Positive Definite Neural Networks for Matrix-CFAR Geometric Signal Detection in Nonhomogeneous Clutter
abstract: arXiv:2611.19820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Matrix information geometry (MIG) detectors exploit the Riemannian geometry of Hermitian positive definite (HPD) matrices to achieve robust object detection in nonhomogeneous clutter. The matrix constant false alarm rate (matrix-CFAR) method is a representative MIG detector that relies on the geometric structures with respect to specific metrics. In most cases, computing representative HPD covariance matrices requires numerical methods, typically involving computationally intensive iterative optimization algorithms. Although explicit formulas are available for certain cases, such as the log-Euclidean (LE) mean, they are generally unavailable for many other matrix means and medians. translated_title: 用于非均匀杂波中矩阵-CFAR几何信号检测的埃尔米特正定神经网络
translated_abstract: 矩阵信息几何（MIG）检测器利用埃尔米特正定（HPD）矩阵的黎曼几何，在非均匀杂波环境中实现鲁棒的目标检测。矩阵恒虚警率（矩阵-CFAR）方法是一种代表性的MIG检测器，其依赖于特定度量下所对应的几何结构。在大多数情况下，计算具有代表性的HPD协方差矩阵需要采用数值方法，通常涉及计算量很大的迭代优化算法。尽管在某些情形下（如对数欧几里得（LE）均值）存在显式公式，但对于许多其他矩阵均值和中值而言，显式公式通常是不可得的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出将埃尔米特正定神经网络（HPDNet）集成到矩阵-CFAR框架中，用一种学习得到的、保持几何结构的映射来替代传统的数值优化过程，直接估计相应的代表性矩阵。
tldr: 该论文提出将HPDNet神经网络嵌入矩阵-CFAR检测框架，用学习得到的保持几何结构的映射替代计算密集的迭代优化算法，从而高效估计代表性HPD协方差矩阵，实现非均匀杂波中更快速鲁棒的几何信号检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes integrating HPDNet into the matrix-CFAR framework, replacing computationally intensive iterative numerical optimization with a learned geometry-preserving mapping to efficiently estimate representative HPD covariance matrices for robust geometric signal detection in nonhomogeneous clutter.
